messages:
vijay (DevEx): Customer hit onboarding friction: ran our Go quickstart in CI, first API call failed with 402 {"error":"billing_not_enabled"}. They used a service account token copied from Console.

vijay (DevEx): Go snippet: ```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RWD_API_KEY"))
resp, _ := client.Generate(context.Background(), redwood.Input{Text: "hi"})
fmt.Println(resp)
```

nora (Support): Do they create workspace via SSO? 402 usually means org admin hasn't accepted billing terms.

vijay (DevEx): Yes SSO. But twist: the CI environment set RWD_WORKSPACE to the org slug of a different sandbox workspace that still has billing disabled. Token belonged to main workspace. Mismatch causes 402.

alejandra (SDK): SDK passes through error; we should try to detect workspace/token mismatch and surface a friendlier message. Also add a quick diagnostic helper in the quickstart: print token-owner workspace and RWD_WORKSPACE when running in CI.

samir (Accounts): We intentionally require explicit Accept Terms for SSO orgs. But the sample app shouldn't set RWD_WORKSPACE in CI images.

vijay (DevEx): Short-term support reply: instruct to unset RWD_WORKSPACE or set to correct slug, or have admin accept billing terms in Console -> Billing. Add CLI command: `rwd workspace refresh --wait-billing`.

alejandra (SDK): I'll add mapping for 402/billing_not_enabled -> "Billing not enabled for workspace. Check Console -> Billing or ensure RWD_WORKSPACE matches token owner. See: https://console.redwood.ai/billing" and include a one-liner diagnostic in Go/Python/Node quickstarts. PR #4801.

deploy-bot: CI deploy queued for quickstart-fixes branch (contains PR #4801).

nora (Support): I'll reply to the reporter with the checklist and screenshot instructions.

samir (Accounts): Filing FR to allow a limited developer sandbox that bypasses the Accept step for one-off trial tokens (FR-233).

vijay (DevEx): Thank you — once PR and docs land I'll update the quickstart README and docker image to avoid defaulting workspace. This should reduce "first call fails" tickets. :white_check_mark:
